prompt_cases.query: Profile this product system and summarize the current stack, users, integrations, and engineering maturity.
What lifecycle stage is this initiative in and which planning artifacts are missing?
Turn this vague product idea into a discovery brief with users, goals, risks, and MVP boundary.
Create a PRD with requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, permissions, and out-of-scope items.
Map the UX flow, screens, user journey, empty states, loading states, and accessibility concerns.
Create a design system for this SaaS MVP with colours, typography, spacing, reusable components, and accessibility rules.
Build a clickable UI prototype with mock data for the onboarding flow.
Create a system map that shows external systems, component boundaries, data flow, and failure points.
Create an architecture plan with module boundaries, technical tradeoffs, ADR candidates, and rollout risks.
Design the data model with entities, relationships, ownership, retention, and migration risks.
Define the API contract including request shape, response shape, auth, pagination, errors, and webhook events.
Break this approved design into a safe implementation plan with slices, dependencies, tests, and rollback.
Implement the checkout feature safely in small verified slices and run the relevant tests.
Review this PR for correctness, security, architecture drift, migration risk, and missing tests.
Create a test strategy covering unit, integration, contract, E2E, regression, security, and manual QA.
Plan the release with rollout steps, feature flags, monitoring, rollback, support notes, and post-release validation.
Run the engineering council for this high-stakes build vs buy tradeoff and preserve dissent.
Update repo hygiene by checking .env.example, .gitignore, generated files, docs drift, and changelog needs.
Build a project dashboard showing lifecycle status, risks, action items, recent artifacts, and release readiness.
Map external systems, workflows, data flow, and failure points for this repo.
Clarify this product idea before requirements by listing users, assumptions, open questions, and MVP boundary.
Review the changed files and report bugs, security issues, and missing tests with file references.
Define colours, typography, spacing, and reusable component standards for this dashboard.
